<thought>Using the monoisotopic m/z 127.0997 and the isotopic pattern, the molecular formula is C₇H₁₃NO (exact mass 127.0997 Da). The DBE is 2, suggesting a carbonyl plus one additional double bond or ring. A structure that fits the formula and DBE is an unsaturated amide: CH₃‑CH₂‑CH=CH‑CH₂‑C(=O)‑NH‑CH₃. Its SMILES representation is `CC=CCC(=O)N(C)`. This SMILES matches the formula C₇H₁₃NO.</thought>
<final_answer>CC=CCC(=O)N(C)</final_answer>
